save_gif: save a tensor sequence as a GIF and PDF with frame numbers and optional init and goal frames
save_gif_as_pdf_unroll: save frames as a horizontally unrolled PDF with row labels and optional init and goal frames
create_comparison_gif: create a comparison GIF with ground truth and prediction sequences side by side with column titles
prepare_frame: convert any torch tensor or numpy array frame to a normalized uint8 HWC format with 3 channels
analyze_distances: analyze distances between observations and a goal state and generate distance and objective plots
